label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off. E2 is direct evidence: the survey team observed and documented an object that looked like explosive ordnance in the area. E3 is also a target as first-hand indirect evidence of unused land. The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance follows for a defined hazardous area with a target. E1 reports only three years of trouble-free fishing along one stream and does not outweigh or explain these findings.
flags: The survey team reports that it marked and reported the E2 location and took a photo; refer this observation to the appropriate qualified personnel.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E2, E3.

E1.quote: A man who hunts and fishes said he started to fish along one of the streams in the area 3 years ago and has had no trouble there.
E1.note: A first-hand land user reports three years of trouble-free use along a stream, supporting absence only for that use and period.

E2.quote: The survey team saw an object that looked like explosive ordnance on the ground at the stream crossing.
E2.note: The survey team directly observed and documented an apparent EO object in the area; this is a target.

E3.quote: The survey team saw that a field in part of the area has been left unused for years, with collapsed fences and overgrown paths, although the land around it is farmed.
E3.note: An unused field amid farmed land is indirect evidence suggesting possible contamination, observed first-hand by the survey team and therefore a target.
